verdict.rationale: Choosing a data storage region is a fair question for an enterprise agent platform like Sierra, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented region or residency selection. The compliance certifications listed (GDPR, FedRAMP High, etc.) are an adjacent posture claim, not a customer-selectable storage location.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
